title: Mt Saint Druqks
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: A euphoric, high-tempo IDM track powered by a thundering four-on-the-floor 909 that accumulates snappy claps, open hats, and rim patterns with each section, pushing toward an almost overwhelming peak. Stacked supersaw chords shimmer and reverse over the top while a saw-wave bassline locks into A minor, the whole thing oscillating between frenzied energy and momentary, delay-soaked breathing spaces.
